C fe001.standalone-feature OL FE-001 DEFAULT ;; Use modern standalone Angular APIs for new code and organize by feature; do not introduce NgModules for ordinary feature development. ;; = ;; NgModules when an integration or legacy dependency genuinely requires them. ;;
C fe007.feature-structure OL FE-007 MUST ;; Keep structure feature-oriented: no application-wide technical buckets (global components/, services/, models/) or empty architecture folders; feature code inside its feature; core/shared small. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe002.presentation OL FE-002 MUST ;; Keep pages/components focused on presentation and UI orchestration; do not move trivial presentation logic into services merely to shrink components. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe004.signals-rxjs OL FE-004 DEFAULT ;; Signals for synchronous local UI state, RxJS for async streams/HTTP composition/cancellation/event pipelines; avoid mechanical conversions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe006.simple-state OL FE-006 PREFER ;; Prefer simple component, signal or feature-service state before a state-management library. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe003.http-boundary OL FE-003 MUST ;; Keep backend communication in explicit feature data-access services/HTTP boundary; no HttpClient calls scattered in presentation components; no backend Domain entities in Angular; use frontend API models matching the published contract. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe008.interceptors OL FE-008 PREFER ;; Prefer functional interceptors for new code; interceptors stay cross-cutting and never contain feature business logic. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe009.api-errors OL FE-009 MUST ;; Follow the documented API error contract; centralize reusable ProblemDetails parsing where practical; do not infer business behaviour from human-readable exception messages. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe005.lazy OL FE-005 DEFAULT ;; Use route-level lazy loading for meaningful features; do not lazy-load every tiny component. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe010.forms OL FE-010 MUST ;; Use reactive forms for non-trivial forms when useful; frontend validation is UX and never replaces backend validation, data integrity or security enforcement. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe011.nested-subs OL FE-011 AVOID ;; Avoid manual nested subscriptions; prefer composition operators when clearer. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe012.sub-lifecycle OL FE-012 MUST ;; Tie manual subscriptions from framework-managed code to the component/service lifecycle using current Angular facilities. ;; = ;; none ;;

C api001.http-in-api OL API-001 MUST ;; HTTP status codes/transport semantics belong to the API layer; Application and Domain must not return IActionResult or ASP.NET Core status codes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api003.success-statuses OL API-003 MUST ;; Choose 200/201/202/204 by actual HTTP semantics (no blanket 200; 201 only when an API resource is created; no 202 for completed work); a 204 response has no body. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api004.empty-collection OL API-004 DEFAULT ;; A successful collection query with zero matches returns 200 with an empty collection, not 404. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api005.401-403 OL API-005 MUST ;; 401 for missing/failed authentication, 403 for authenticated but not permitted; 404 hiding must be a deliberate consistent security policy. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api006.409-412 OL API-006 MUST ;; 409 for valid requests conflicting with current state; 412 when an explicit HTTP precondition such as If-Match fails. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.api-consistent-status EX API-003 MUST ;; Keep status-code behaviour consistent across similar endpoints. ;; = ;; none ;; Cross-endpoint consistency obligation; oracle API policies define per-outcome semantics and stable error contracts but not consistency across similar endpoints.
C api013.versioning-need OL API-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not introduce API versioning merely because an API exists; add it when published compatibility or coexistence of client generations creates a concrete need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api014.breaking OL API-014 MUST ;; Once a version is relied on by external clients avoid silent breaking changes; a breaking change requires by default a new version or explicitly approved compatibility strategy; do not judge compatibility only by compilation. ;; = ;; Explicitly approved alternative compatibility strategy. ;;
C api015.strategy OL API-015 DEFAULT ;; Use one versioning strategy consistently; URL-segment (/api/v1/...) is default unless requirements justify header or query string. ;; = ;; Project requirements justify another strategy. ;;
C api016.swagger-truth OL API-016 MUST ;; Swagger/OpenAPI metadata describes the API that actually runs (routes, important statuses incl. binding/validation/auth/rate limiting/central exception handling, schemas, auth); no speculative responses. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api017.swagger-env OL API-017 DEFAULT ;; Enable Swagger UI in Development by default; expose elsewhere only when deployment requirements explicitly justify it. ;; = ;; Deployment requirements justify. ;;
C api018.health-cheap OL API-018 MUST ;; Health checks stay cheap and deterministic; no full business workflows or expensive/mutating database work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api019.liveness-readiness OL API-019 MUST ;; Keep liveness and readiness distinct: liveness avoids external dependencies by default; readiness may depend on required capabilities and stays unhealthy until required startup work completes (never use liveness for that). ;; = ;; none ;;
C api020.health-public OL API-020 MUST_NOT ;; Publicly reachable health responses must not expose secrets, credentials, connection details, stack traces or unnecessary diagnostics. ;; = ;; none ;;

C arc001.inward OL ARC-001 MUST ;; Dependencies point inward: Domain depends on no other project; Application on Domain; Infrastructure on Application and Domain; Api on Application and Infrastructure only for composition/registration; inner layers never depend on outer layers; Domain/Application never reference Infrastructure-specific types. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.reconsider-boundary OL ARC-001 MUST ;; If a feature seems to require an outward reference, reconsider the abstraction boundary instead of adding the reference. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.prod-graph OL ARC-001 MUST ;; Production reference graph: Domain→none, Application→Domain, Infrastructure→Application+Domain, Api→Application+Infrastructure; never Domain→Application/Infrastructure or Application→Infrastructure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc028.narrow-test-refs OL ARC-028 MUST_NOT ;; Backend test projects get no broader production references than their scope requires and keep inward discipline. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc028.test-ref-map OL ARC-028 MUST ;; Test reference allow-list: Domain.Tests→Domain; Application.Tests→Application (+Domain as needed); IntegrationTests→Api (WebApplicationFactory<Program>); Infrastructure.Tests→Infrastructure (narrower as required). ;; = ;; Narrower references as required. ;;
C x.arch-test-project-names EX ARC-028,DEP-013 DEFAULT ;; Backend test projects follow the canonical set <Name>.Domain.Tests (optional), <Name>.Application.Tests, <Name>.IntegrationTests, <Name>.Infrastructure.Tests (optional). ;; = ;; Domain.Tests and Infrastructure.Tests optional. ;; Oracle constrains test references and location but not test-project naming/roles; this fixes a naming convention (also relied on by check-manifests).
C arc002.domain-independent OL ARC-002 MUST ;; Keep Domain free of EF Core, ASP.NET Core, HTTP, persistence and external-service implementation concerns. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc003.simple-domain-rule OL ARC-003 DEFAULT ;; Simple domain entities are default; CRUD/straightforward workflow rules are enforced in Application Services; validation rules, immutable fields, status transitions or allowed edits alone do not justify a Rich Domain Model. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc004.rich-domain-approval OL ARC-004 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Move behaviour into Domain only when non-trivial invariants materially benefit from domain-level encapsulation independent of a use case; otherwise Rich Domain/DDD tactical patterns require explicit approval. ;; = ;; Unless the approved specification already requires that design. ;;
C arc005.no-decorative-ddd OL ARC-005 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add factory methods, private setters, transition methods, Aggregate Roots, Domain Events, Specifications, Domain Services, systematic Value Objects or similar merely to appear domain-driven. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc006.appsvc-rule OL ARC-006,ARC-009 DEFAULT ;; Application Services are the default orchestration mechanism; an oversized service is a signal to reconsider responsibilities, not to introduce another pattern. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc007.app-abstractions OL ARC-007 MUST ;; Define persistence and external-service abstractions in Application when use cases require them; keep infrastructure details out of Application. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc008.no-ef-in-app OL ARC-008 MUST_NOT ;; Application must not use DbContext, DbSet<T>, EF Core APIs, provider-specific types or ASP.NET Core transport types. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc010.thin-controllers OL ARC-010 MUST ;; Controllers are the default HTTP entry point and stay thin: bind/validate input, invoke Application services, translate outcomes to HTTP responses. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc010.no-minimal-api OL ARC-010,DEP-008 MUST_NOT ;; Do not create Minimal API endpoint groups unless explicitly requested. ;; = ;; Explicit request. ;;
C arc011.controller-limits OL ARC-011 MUST_NOT ;; Controllers must not contain business logic, access DbContext or concrete repositories, or construct infrastructure services manually. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc012.composition-root OL ARC-012 DEFAULT ;; Program.cs is the composition root and may register Infrastructure implementations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.controllers-no-infra-types OL ARC-001,ARC-011 MUST_NOT ;; Controllers do not consume Infrastructure implementation types directly. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc013.specific-repos-rule OL ARC-013 PREFER ;; Prefer specific repository interfaces for cohesive Application persistence needs over table-mirroring generic CRUD contracts. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc007.repo-interfaces-in-app OL ARC-007 MUST ;; Define repository interfaces in Application and implement them in Infrastructure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc014.no-iqueryable OL ARC-014 MUST_NOT ;; Repository interfaces must not expose IQueryable<T>, DbSet<T>, DbContext, EF expressions or provider types; LINQ-to-EF stays in Infrastructure; return materialized entities/collections/projections/result models. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc015.generic-repo OL ARC-015,ARC-019 MUST_NOT ;; Application must not depend on IGenericRepository<T>/generic CRUD contracts; a generic repository/base class may exist only in Infrastructure to remove genuine duplication and must not become a replacement for EF Core queries; use-case queries live in concrete repositories. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc016.uow-rule OL ARC-016 DEFAULT ;; IUnitOfWork (SaveChangesAsync) is the default commit boundary; repositories stage and do not call SaveChangesAsync; Application Services decide when to commit; Infrastructure implements IUnitOfWork with the DbContext. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc017.shared-context OL ARC-017 MUST ;; Repositories in one use case share the same Unit of Work and scoped DbContext; repositories injected explicitly; IUnitOfWork is not a repository container/service locator. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc018.transactions OL ARC-018 DEFAULT ;; Do not introduce explicit transaction APIs until a concrete use case needs control beyond SaveChangesAsync. ;; = ;; Concrete use case. ;;
C arc019.ef-boundary OL ARC-019 MUST ;; EF Core is an Infrastructure detail used with full capabilities inside Infrastructure; do not leak EF concepts into Application; do not cripple repository implementations to preserve a generic abstraction. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc021.ctor-injection OL ARC-021 DEFAULT ;; Constructor injection for required dependencies; avoid service-locator and property injection. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc022.lifetimes OL ARC-022 MUST ;; Respect lifetimes; never capture a shorter-lived (e.g. scoped) dependency in a longer-lived service. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc023.registration OL ARC-023 DEFAULT ;; Registration near the owning layer: Application registers Application services, Infrastructure registers persistence/adapters, Api is the composition root. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run022.typed-options OL RUN-022 PREFER ;; Prefer strongly typed options, validate at startup when missing/invalid values prevent correct/secure operation, avoid scattered string IConfiguration lookups (direct IConfiguration belongs to composition/registration). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep021.addserilog OL DEP-021 DEFAULT ;; When Serilog is configured use builder.Services.AddSerilog(...) rather than UseSerilog; keep provider configuration in environment-aware configuration; application code depends on ILogger<T>. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc024.cache-boundary OL ARC-024 MUST ;; Keep cache technology out of Domain; do not leak infrastructure cache APIs into Application without a deliberate boundary abstraction. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc025.http-transport OL ARC-025 MUST ;; Infrastructure translates remote HTTP responses into Application-facing abstractions; no HttpResponseMessage/remote transport concerns in Application. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc026.versioned-models OL ARC-026 MUST_NOT ;; Do not create separate Domain/persistence models merely for multiple API versions; isolate version-specific transport contracts at the API boundary when practical. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc029.dto-dup OL ARC-029 MUST_NOT ;; Do not duplicate equivalent DTOs across Api and Application merely for layer-shaped types; introduce transport contracts when separation gives a concrete boundary benefit. ;; = ;; none ;;

@scope path-scoped: backend/**/*.cs

20 NN ;; Heading.
22-28 OL [run024.file-async,run011.no-rename-reorder]
30 NN ;; Heading.
32-36 MX [x.cs-constructors,run009.no-mechanical] ;; Constructor-choice criteria are added style rules; 'Do not convert constructors mechanically' is RUN-009.
37-40 EX [x.cs-records]
41-44 EX [x.cs-visibility-sealed]

48-49 EX [x.cs-var]

55 NN ;; Heading.
57-58 OL [run013.structured-logging]
60 NN ;; Heading.
62-64 MX [run011.no-style-rewrites,x.cs-no-mixing-format] ;; RUN-011 prohibition plus an added caution against mixing large formatting/modernization changes with functional work.
65 NN ;; End of pointer sentence (line 64-65): unused-using removal is owned by verify (captured there).
O 64-65 NN ;; Pointer sentence; the obligation itself (RUN-010) is owned and captured in verify, so this restatement is not an independent rule. ;; ;; Removing unused `using` directives from changed files is a

C run009.conventions OL RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Follow repository conventions and .editorconfig; use modern C# when it improves clarity; do not rewrite working code solely for newer syntax; consistency and readability over maximal feature use. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run024.file-async OL RUN-024 PREFER ;; For new C# code prefer file-scoped namespaces (when consistent), one primary top-level type per matching file, Async suffix for Task/ValueTask methods. ;; = ;; Small private/nested supporting types may stay with the owning type; Async suffix not required when an existing interface/framework contract makes it inappropriate. ;;
C run011.no-rename-reorder OL RUN-011,RUN-024 MUST_NOT ;; Do not rename established APIs solely to add the Async suffix; do not reorganize existing files merely for preferred member ordering. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cs-constructors EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Primary constructors fit DI or simple clear initialization; use a regular constructor when validation/initialization is non-trivial, explicit fields improve readability, the codebase uses that style, or parameter capture hurts understanding. ;; = ;; none ;; Constructor-style selection criteria; oracle (RUN-009, EXC-002/EXC-003) leaves constructor preferences outside the policy set.
C run009.no-mechanical OL RUN-009 MUST_NOT ;; Do not convert constructors mechanically. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cs-records EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Use records when value semantics/immutability are desirable (many DTOs, genuine Value Objects) and classes when identity, mutable lifecycle, inheritance or framework behaviour fit; do not turn every DTO or Domain type into a record. ;; = ;; none ;; Record/class selection style rule not in the oracle (EXC-003 lists record preferences as outside it).
C x.cs-visibility-sealed EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Keep implementation details non-public unless part of the public API; use sealed to communicate deliberate non-inheritance, not as speculative JIT optimization. ;; = ;; none ;; Visibility/sealed conventions are not in the oracle.
C run009.modern-when-clearer OL RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Use collection expressions, pattern matching, switch expressions, target-typed construction and other modern features only when they make code easier to read. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cs-var EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Use var when the type is obvious or unimportant; explicit type when it improves clarity. ;; = ;; none ;; Type-inference style convention outside the oracle.
C x.cs-naming EX RUN-009 MUST ;; Use standard .NET naming (PascalCase types/methods/properties/public members, camelCase parameters/locals, meaningful names); private-field naming follows the repository convention. ;; = ;; Private-field naming follows established repository convention. ;; Concrete naming convention not stated in any oracle policy (RUN-009 only defers to existing conventions).
C run013.structured-logging OL RUN-013 DEFAULT ;; Use ILogger<T> with structured message templates and stable property names; avoid string interpolation in log calls. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run011.no-style-rewrites OL RUN-011 MUST_NOT ;; Do not perform style-only rewrites outside the requested change unless explicitly asked. ;; = ;; Explicit request. ;;
C x.cs-no-mixing-format EX RUN-011 AVOID ;; Avoid mixing large formatting or modernization changes with functional work. ;; = ;; none ;; RUN-011 limits style rewrites outside the requested change; avoiding large formatting/modernization changes mixed into functional work within the change is additional.
